subject: Re: Nanoflow: erasure request for sandbox prompts & logs - confirmation needed
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@nanoflow.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataOps Team <dataops@nanoflow.com>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Erasure request: sandbox prompts, outputs, and inference logs (Nanoflow account)

Hi Lukas,

We need Redwood to perform a complete erase of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and related inference logs for our sandbox environment (namespace: nanoflow-sbx-2027) as part of an internal audit. Scope: prompt logs (kv-cache snapshots and transcript logs), per-request metadata (request ids, timestamps), and any short-term inference traces stored in S3/logging buckets.

Deliverables we require:
- Confirmation of deletion completion with timestamps
- Evidence bundle (checksums + a list of removed object keys)
- Approx ETA and expected run window (we prefer non-business hours PT)

Is there any data we should expect to remain (e.g., aggregated metrics, billing counters)? Please include the runbook you will follow and a point of contact.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Data Engineer
Nanoflow Labs

Attachments: None
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@nanoflow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Erasure request: sandbox prompts, outputs, and inference logs (Nanoflow account)

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear scope. We're able to run a targeted sweep for namespace nanoflow-sbx-2027. High-level plan below; ops will follow up with exact timestamps and evidence artifacts.

Planned approach:
1) Validate identifiers and scope (confirm list of buckets & namespaces)
2) Snapshot current state (manifest + checksums)
3) Quiesce ingestion for the sandbox window (short maintenance window)
4) Execute purge:
   - kv-cache prefixes (LRU/ttl-eligible keys)
   - transcript blobs in s3://redwood-logs/nanoflow-sbx-2027/
   - ephemeral inference traces and per-request metadata in logging DB
5) Run verification pass and generate evidence bundle (sha256 checksums, removal list)
6) Deliver evidence + close ticket

I'll loop in Marissa for the execution timeline. Can you confirm: 1) you want the run during the 01:00-04:00 PT window next Tuesday (2028-05-09)? 2) any regulatory formality we should follow for this audit?

Shared runbook (preliminary): https://redwood-internal/runbooks/erasure-v2 (we'll attach a PDF for your records).

Best,
Lukas
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 6 May 2028 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Erasure request: sandbox prompts, outputs, and inference logs (Nanoflow account)

Priya — outlining concrete ops steps and the artifacts we'll deliver. Quoting your original ask below for clarity.

On Sat, May 5, 2028 at 09:12 AM Priya Sharma <priya@nanoflow.com> wrote:
> We need Redwood to perform a complete erase of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and related inference logs for our sandbox environment (namespace: nanoflow-sbx-2027) as part of an internal audit.

Ops execution plan (detailed):
- Pre-check (T-24h): collect list of object keys, generate manifest nanoflow-erasure-manifest.csv, snapshot of current KV indexes.
- Maintenance window (01:00-03:00 PT, Tue 2028-05-09):
   * Pause request routing to the sandbox pool for 10 minutes
   * Delete KV prefixes with tombstone policy; run two-pass delete to remove derivatives
   * Remove transcript blobs from S3 and lifecycle-mark ephemeral logs for purge if immutability prevents immediate delete; we will record object statuses
   * Purge logging DB rows older than cutoff IDs associated to namespace
- Post-run (T+1h): verification job that attempts to read deleted keys, compiles removal-list.json and produces checksums.

Evidence we will attach: nanoflow-erasure-manifest.csv, runbook_v2.pdf, nanoflow-erasure-archive-20280507.zip (contains removal-list.json and sha256.txt). We'll also update ticket RED-11234 with run logs.

Notes / expectations: aggregated metrics (system-level telemetry) are retained for billing/monitoring purposes and are not included in the purge. We will redact any item that we cannot delete due to legal hold and flag them in the manifest.

Can you confirm you accept the window and the evidence set? If yes, we will schedule the job and provide a DocuSign link for audit attestation (Neha will lead legal sign-off).

- Marissa
Director, Production Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook_v2.pdf (stub)

Thanks — window works for us. A couple of clarifying asks before you run:
- Please include sha256 checksums for the removed objects (we need those for internal validation).
- If any keys are retained because of immutability or legal hold, please include an explanation field in the manifest and a ticket reference.
- We prefer evidence delivery via encrypted ZIP to the support ticket; S3 links are fine only if pre-signed and set to expire within 7 days.

Accepted: Tue 2028-05-09 01:00-03:00 PT. Please proceed and mark the ticket RED-11234 as scheduled.

Best,
Priya
